name: 1 Samuel
title: 1 Samuel — From Judges to King
tagline: The LORD raises and rejects kings; the heart is His.

date.range_display: Transition to monarchy (c. 11th cent. BC setting).

audience: Israel under kings; readers learning true kingship.
purpose: Narrate Saul’s rise/fall and David’s anointing.
christ: Anointed king after God’s heart points beyond David to Christ.
spirit: Spirit rushes on Saul then departs; Spirit on David — warning and hope.
jesus_in_this_book: Anointed king after God’s heart points beyond David to Christ.
how_to_read: Watch the heart, not the resume.
watchman_charge: Do not keep partial obedience and call it worship.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
